title: AdaST: Adaptive Coupling for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.36119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial-temporal (ST) forecasting underpins many real-world systems such as traffic, climate, and energy networks. While existing methods implicitly assume strong spatiotemporal coupling, we observe that real-world ST data exhibits distinct coupling regimes, ranging from temporal-dominated and spatial-dominated to strongly coupled patterns. This mismatch causes current models to suffer from spurious dependencies and degraded performance when one correlation dominates. To overcome this limitation, we aim to dynamically modulate spatial and temporal modeling based on the data's inherent coupling structure. However, three key challenges exist: unknown coupling structure, heterogeneous coupling dynamics, and suboptimal spatial modeling. We propose AdaST, an adaptive ST forecasting framework that tackles these challenges through a decompose-recompose paradigm. translated_title: AdaST：面向时空预测的自适应耦合
translated_abstract: 时空（ST）预测支撑着许多现实世界系统，例如交通、气候和能源网络。虽然现有方法隐含地假设了强时空耦合，但我们观察到现实世界的时空数据表现出不同的耦合模式，从时间主导、空间主导到强耦合模式。这种不匹配导致当前模型在某一相关性占主导时会受到虚假依赖和性能下降的影响。为了克服这一局限，我们旨在根据数据固有的耦合结构动态调节空间与时间建模。然而，存在三个关键挑战：未知的耦合结构、异构的耦合动态以及次优的空间建模。我们提出了AdaST，一个通过分解-重组范式来应对这些挑战的自适应时空预测框架。AdaST利用（原文此处截断）将输入分解为捕获不同耦合模式的多个组件。
tldr: 提出AdaST自适应时空预测框架，通过分解-重组范式根据数据固有的耦合结构动态调节空间与时间建模，解决了现有模型在单一相关性主导时性能下降的问题。
en_tdlr: AdaST is an adaptive spatial-temporal forecasting framework that dynamically modulates spatial and temporal modeling through a decompose-recompose paradigm based on the data's inherent coupling structure, addressing performance degradation when one correlation dominates.
